meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会去检索你在 cmem.ai 上的 Claude-Mem 记忆——来自你各个 agent 过往会话的带时间戳观察记录。它先做宽泛关键词搜索，再用精确词收窄，最后用平实语言综合回答，而不是把原始搜索输出丢给你。
howto.when: 当你说「搜索记忆」「你还记得关于 X 什么」「上次会话我们做了什么」，或想了解某个项目、决定、文件、任务的既往上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索记忆：上次我们在这个项目里做了什么？
say.note: Claude 会返回相关观察，问「什么时候」时引用时间戳。

say.text: 你还记得关于这个报错字符串的记录吗？
say.note: 它会改用该精确词收窄搜索。

say.text: 运行 mem 状态检查，看看搜索为什么没结果。
say.note: 会平实报告 API key 与端点状态。

howto.what_en: Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions across your agents. It tries broad keyword passes, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", check claude-mem, or want prior-session context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory: what did we do on this project last session?
say_en.note: Claude returns relevant observations, with timestamps if asked.

say_en.text: Do you remember anything about this error string?
say_en.note: It re-searches with that specific term.

say_en.text: Run mem status to see why the search returned nothing.
say_en.note: Reports API key and endpoint status plainly.
